title: Acyclicity for the pulled-back free abelian source
statement: For commutative Λ:Type(u+1), f:X→S and U in S.Etale, every injective module sheaf I on X has forget(I) right-acyclic for the additive Hom functor from f^*Z[U], with Z[U] the fixed free abelian represented sheaf of def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison.

source.place: Tag 03FD, second proof paragraph and the free represented sections adjunction

proof.text: Compose inverse-image adjunction, sheafification adjunction, free-group adjunction and ulift Yoneda to identify Hom(f^*Z[U],G) with G(X×_S U). Reuse the explicit representedEquiv and representedEquiv_apply in RawRestrictedHomotopySectionsIso. Prove additivity by its evaluation formula and naturality by the three homEquiv_naturality_right identities. The resulting components define rawSourceSectionsIso from additive Hom to evaluation.

Apply NatTrans.rightDerived to both directions of rawSourceSectionsIso. The rightDerived identity and composition laws prove these derived natural transformations inverse. The existing evaluation acyclicity helper with coefficients in Type(u+1) gives zero in degree n+1. Transport zero along the derived component iso.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03FD, second proof paragraph and the free represented sections adjunction; existing library computations and the explicit comparison reduction

mathlib_searches.query: Exact functor derived Hom comparison is injective when source Hom comparisons are bijective on injectives and forgotten injectives are acyclic
A pulled back free abelian represented sheaf corepresents evaluation and underlying injective module sheaves are acyclic for its Hom functor
mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf.H, cohomologyPresheafFunctor, GabrielPopescu.preservesInjectiveObjects; no matching scalar comparison.
InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and its apply/symm lemmas exist in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Injective.Ext.

No duplicate raw injectivity theorem. Found the free sections adjunction, ExtRightDerivedHom, the acyclic-resolution API, representedEquiv in RawRestrictedHomotopySectionsIso, and the proved evaluation-acyclicity helper in ModuleAbelianDerivedDirectImageComparison. The common-universe generic ringed-site lemma does not directly fit coefficients in u+1.
mathlib_searches.verdict: reuse existing constructions; isolate two missing comparison steps

from.place: Resolution argument for the injective part of the explicit raw scalar comparison

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleFreeSource_acyclic
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : S.Etale) (I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [Injective I] :
    (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U)))).rightAcyclic
      ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ X).obj I)
